headline_ko: SBA PPP $245M 사기 적발 등 신규 6건
headline_en: SBA PPP $245M fraud bust, 5 other new incidents
briefing_ko:
- **[RsETHSafeModule](https://github.com/SunWeb3Sec/DeFiHackLabs/blob/main/src/test/2026-09/RsETHSafeModule_exp.sol)** (Ethereum) — 중첩 멀티콜·DELEGATECALL로 $7.8M 탈취, 기존 블랙리스트 2개 재등장.
- **[Nostra Money Market](https://defillama.com/hacks)** (—) — Oracle Spot Price Manipulation으로 $3.5M 손실.
- **SBA Paycheck Protection Program** — $245M 규모 사기 적발, 160명 이상 피고인.
- **BitBank** — IRGC에 대량 비트코인 전송 혐의로 OFAC 제재, 주소 등재 없음.
- **소액** — Christopher Michael Cadman $25K.
- **시사점** — Oracle Spot Price Manipulation이 계속 악용되고 있습니다.
briefing_en:
- **[RsETHSafeModule](https://github.com/SunWeb3Sec/DeFiHackLabs/blob/main/src/test/2026-09/RsETHSafeModule_exp.sol)** (Ethereum) — nested multicall & DELEGATECALL stole $7.8M; 2 on our blacklist.
- **[Nostra Money Market](https://defillama.com/hacks)** (—) — oracle spot-price manipulation caused $3.5M loss.
- **SBA Paycheck Protection Program** — $245M fraud scheme busted, over 160 defendants.
- **BitBank** — massive Bitcoin transfers to IRGC led to OFAC sanction.
- **Smaller** — Christopher Michael Cadman $25K.
- **Takeaway** — Oracle spot-price manipulation remains a common exploit vector.
